calculate_bbox_iou: calculate intersection over union between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps
calculate_bbox_iof: calculate intersection over foreground between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps with mode iof
calculate_aligned_bbox_overlaps: calculate pairwise IoU between aligned bounding box pairs using bbox_overlaps with aligned mode
calculate_cpu_bbox_overlaps: calculate bounding box overlaps on CPU using the _bbox_overlaps_cpu pure PyTorch implementation
handle_empty_bbox_overlaps: handle edge cases with empty bounding box tensors using bbox_overlaps which returns correctly shaped zero tensors
